[[Category: Adams County, Ohio]]

== Biography ==
William was born in 1818. He was the son of [[Glasgow-563|William Glasgow]] and [[Montgomery-6593|Rhoda Montgomery]].  He passed away in 1886. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Father identification ===

[[Glasgow-563|William Glasgow]] is confidently inferred to be William Madison’s father, assessed 94%. A previously reported 1850 Scott Township, Adams County, Ohio census extract lists William, 72, born Virginia, followed by Madison, 32, born Ohio; Margaret, 27, born New York; Mary A 9, Eliza J 6, Rhoda 3 and Wm W1, born Ohio. The younger couple and four children match William Madison’s known family. Together with the specific compiled father attribution and compatible family chronology, this supports father and adult son substantially more strongly than a name match.<ref name="Reported1850Scott">Reported extract in [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-563 William Glasgow’s compiled biography], “Residences and Life Experiences”, labelled “Wm Glasgow in the 1850 United States Federal Census”. This is a derivative transcription; no original census page, roll, dwelling/family number or record URL has been recovered. The original image and household boundaries were not newly verified22 October 2026.</ref>

This is an inference for the complete father–son identification, not a census entry explicitly saying “son”. The reported group and the modern family details may share a source and are not independent confirmations. The 94% is a subjective assessment conditional on the retained extract; another relationship or a transcription/grouping error remains possible. Rhoda Montgomery’s maternity and William’s earlier ancestry are assessed separately. The original 1850 return and the underlying family/probate evidence remain worthwhile checks.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 — superseded by the assessment above ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-563]] is assessed at 78% (probable). William Madison’s retained account explicitly names William Glasgow and Rhoda Montgomery as parents. His 1818 birth fits their established Adams County family and distinguishes him by full name from his father. The held census citations support his later identity but do not independently name his father.

Probable 78%; specific compiled-family attribution, with parent-naming original evidence outstanding.

Next useful test: Read his Faris family entry or obituary for the parent attribution.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1938 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1938]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.
